The '''Iceberg Four Battle Group''' was one many [[Battle group/Legends|subdivisions]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Galactic Alliance Navy]], that saw action during the [[Defense of Mon Calamari (Yuuzhan Vong War)|defense of Mon Calamari]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. It was named after the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iceberg Four]].<ref name="TUF" />
